items.name: jev-search
items.title: jev-search
items.description: Command-palette site search. Keyword hits on the first keystroke, re-ranked by TypeSafe's Jev model a few hundred milliseconds later. Ships the component, the hook, the lexical index, the server handler and an API route.
items.author: Kyle McLaren
items.docs: Set TYPESAFE_API_KEY, replace lib/jev-search-index.json with your own documents (or run the jev-search-indexer), then render <JevSearch /> anywhere.

items.name: jev-search-indexer
items.title: jev-search indexer
items.description: Builds lib/jev-search-index.json from a folder of Markdown or MDX, one document per page and one per h2 heading.
items.docs: Run: bunx tsx scripts/jev-search-index.ts content/docs /docs lib/jev-search-index.json
